name: My Cup of Coffee: Earl Grey Forever After
source:
In this spin-off, you take on the life of someone (female, male, or genderfree) who, despite their own misgivings, is arranging a marriage to the earl. But somebody is determined to scare you away. Will you put your life on the line to reach a happy ending?

There are 3 unlockable endings, plus an easter egg.

[From [url=https://dreamgate.itch.io/trouble-with-earl-grey]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部衍生剧中，你将扮演一个人（女性、男性或无性别）的生活，尽管他们自己心存疑虑，但他正在安排与伯爵的婚姻。但有人铁了心要把你吓跑。你愿意赌上自己的生命来获得幸福的结局吗？

有3个可解锁的结局，外加一个复活节彩蛋。

[来自[url=https://dreamgate.itch.io/trouble-with-earl-grey]itch.io[/url]]
